title: Same render target rebound with the other flipY reuses the open pass and keeps pipelines keyed to the old front face
expected_finding: the second draw into renderTexture uses a uProjectionMatrix whose Y axis is negated (flipY = true), which reverses the screen-space winding of every triangle, but it is drawn with the same COUNTER_CLOCKWISE-front, back-culling pipeline as the unflipped first draw; culling keeps the CW (back) triangle and drops the CCW (front) one
